mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate rises above 6% in the following 3 months, or core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation falls below 2% in the following 6 months, or industrial production rebounds to year-over-year growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate falls below 2% in the following 6 months, or S&P 500 returns are positive in > 60% of 20-day periods following a rate hike above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts rebound to year-over-year growth > 5% in the following 6 months, or S&P 500 returns are positive in > 60% of 60-day periods following a sharp drop in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment, as measured by the month-over-month change in PAYEMS, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Payroll employment growth falls below 100,000 jobs per month in the following 3 months, or S&P 500 returns are negative in > 40% of 20-day periods following a sharp rise in payroll employment.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real estate loan balances, as measured by the year-over-year change in RSAFS, signals a credit-driven expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real estate loan balances fall year-over-year in the following 6 months, or S&P 500 returns are negative in > 40% of 60-day periods following a sharp rise in real estate loans.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL, signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation falls below 2% in the following 6 months, or S&P 500 returns are positive in > 60% of 20-day periods following a sharp rise in CPI.
